title: Biological effects of p-PYA ligands on certain trace elements of group-12 towards DNA binding and cytotoxicity potency.
authors: Masood, Sara; Nawaz, Bushra; Javed, Kashif; Rashid, Zahid; Sumrra, Sajjad Hussain; Chaudhry, Gul-E-Saba; Zafar, M Naveed
journal: Biometals : an international journal on the role of metal ions in biology, biochemistry, and medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Cd(II)/Zn(II)配合物与DNA的结合及抗癌活性，虽含分子对接和DFT，但核心是金属配合物-DNA互作而非TF-DNA体系，方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: The substantial anticancer potential of inexpensive trace metal-based coordination compounds has been seen to convey enormous significance in the area of cancer therapy. Herein, the present work portrays the synthesis of four new Cd(II) and Zn(II) complexes of general formula, [M(LRp)(X)2] , where M = Zn(II) or Cd(II) and X = I(-) or Cl(-), encompassing the pincer-shaped pyridylidene amide derivatives of LMe p  = N(2),N(6)-bis(1-methylpyridin-4(1H)-ylidene)pyridine-2,6-dicarboxamide and LBnp  = N(2),N(6)-bis(1-benzylpyridin-4(1H)-ylidene)pyridine-2,6-dicarboxamide. The synthesized drug candidates were characterized through NMR ((1)H and (13)C), FT-IR spectroscopy and elemental analysis. Geometry optimization, frontier orbital analysis and electronic characteristics were investigated by DFT studies. Compounds 1-7 interacted with DNA, showing moderate binding affinity to CT DNA (K(b) = 1.8 to 9.4 x 10(4) M(-1)) and stabilizing the duplex through mixed binding mechanisms, supported by molecular docking studies. Complexes (4-7) were determined to be stable during the examined time by using electronic spectroscopy and (1)HNMR analysis of their solutions. The MTT assay was used to evaluate the cytotoxicity of ligands and complexes. The Annexin V-FITC apoptosis detection and terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase dUTP nick-end labeling (TUNEL) assays were used to assess early apoptosis and DNA fragmentation, respectively. By employing the Caspase-Glo assay to investigate pro-apoptotic caspase activation, the fundamental mechanism of DNA fragmentation was further clarified. The in vitro cytotoxicity of the compounds was evaluated against breast cancer cell lines (MCF-7, T47D) and the Vero cell line as a representative of normal cells. Complexes 6 (12.2 +/- 0.3 microM) and 7 (10.0 +/- 3.6 microM) exhibited remarkable anticancer activity compared to complexes 4 (40.0 +/- 0.8 microM), 5 (29.0 +/- 2.8 microM), and cisplatin (25.1 +/- 1.1 microM) against the T47D cell line. Furthermore, complexes 6 and 7 induced DNA fragmentation through the initiation of early and late apoptosis, accompanied by the activation of apoptotic signaling cascades (caspase-3/7 and caspase-9), thereby confirming apoptosis as the underlying mechanism of cell death in the breast cancer cell line.
abstract_zh: 廉价微量金属基配位化合物在癌症治疗领域展现出显著的抗癌潜力，具有重大意义。本研究描述了四种新型Cd(II)和Zn(II)配合物的合成，其通式为[M(LRp)(X)2]，其中M = Zn(II)或Cd(II)，X = I(-)或Cl(-)，包含钳形吡啶亚基酰胺衍生物LMe p = N(2),N(6)-双(1-甲基吡啶-4(1H)-亚基)吡啶-2,6-二甲酰胺和LBnp = N(2),N(6)-双(1-苄基吡啶-4(1H)-亚基)吡啶-2,6-二甲酰胺。合成的候选药物通过NMR（(1)H和(13)C）、FT-IR光谱和元素分析进行了表征。通过DFT研究进行了几何优化、前沿轨道分析和电子特性研究。化合物1-7与DNA相互作用，显示出对CT DNA的中等结合亲和力（K(b) = 1.8至9.4 x 10(4) M(-1)），并通过混合结合机制稳定双链，分子对接研究支持了这一结果。通过电子光谱和(1)HNMR分析其溶液，确定配合物（4-7）在检测时间内保持稳定。使用MTT实验评估配体和配合物的细胞毒性。采用Annexin V-FITC凋亡检测和末端脱氧核苷酸转移酶dUTP缺口末端标记（TUNEL）实验分别评估早期凋亡和DNA片段化。通过使用Caspase-Glo实验研究促凋亡caspase激活，进一步阐明了DNA片段化的基本机制。化合物的体外细胞毒性针对乳腺癌细胞系（MCF-7、T47D）和作为正常细胞代表的Vero细胞系进行了评估。配合物6（12.2 +/- 0.3微M）和7（10.0 +/- 3.6微M）在T47D细胞系中表现出显著的抗癌活性，优于配合物4（40.0 +/- 0.8微M）、5（29.0 +/- 2.8微M）和顺铂（25.1 +/- 1.1微M）。此外，配合物6和7通过启动早期和晚期凋亡诱导DNA片段化，并伴随凋亡信号级联（caspase-3/7和caspase-9）的激活，从而确认凋亡是乳腺癌细胞系中细胞死亡的潜在机制。
